content.text: Can you provide a link to the war file you are using?
I am not seeing this error from:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Downloads
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Downloads
is where I found the link "Fedora 4.0.0-beta-02 webapp with authorization" (
https://oss.sonatype.org/service/local/repositories/releases/content/org/fcrepo/fcrepo-webapp/4.0.0-beta-02/fcrepo-webapp-4.0.0-beta-02-auth.war)
.  I just fetched it again.  It's identical to the WAR I used.  I unpacked the new one, and WEB-INF/web.xml contains no <security-role/> elements.
Hmm, I see the warnings, but startup continues successfully. I have created a ticket in pivotal-tracker for adding the elements.
https://www.pivotaltracker.com/story/show/77658788
Did you happen to configure your tomcat-users.xml as described here:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/How+to+Configure+Servlet+Container+Authentication#HowtoConfigureServletContainerAuthentication-Tomcat
In an attempt to reproduce this error, I replaced my customized tomcat-users.xml with an unmodified version... still no error.
, could you include your catalina.out with this ticket to help debug the issue?
sigh

Well, after several restarts and reconfigurations to fix another problem, I cannot reproduce the failure.  I must have had something misconfigured, but I don't know what.  Sorry to trouble you – this Issue can be closed.
Unable to reproduce
web.xml is missing <security-role/>s for fedoraUser and fedoraAdmin.  This causes startup to fail:
Aug 26, 2014 1:13:32 PM org.apache.catalina.startup.ContextConfig validateSecurityRoles
INFO: WARNING: Security role name fedoraUser used in an <auth-constraint> without being defined in a <security-role>
Aug 26, 2014 1:13:32 PM org.apache.catalina.startup.ContextConfig validateSecurityRoles
INFO: WARNING: Security role name fedoraAdmin used in an <auth-constraint> without being defined in a <security-role>
Aug 26, 2014 1:13:36 PM org.apache.catalina.core.StandardContext startInternal
SEVERE: Error listenerStart
Aug 26, 2014 1:13:36 PM org.apache.catalina.core.StandardContext startInternal
SEVERE: Context
/fedora4
startup failed due to previous errors
Adding them allows startup to proceed to the next, unrelated failure (
Gentoo Linux; Tomcat 7.0.42 from distro; fcrepo-webapp-4.0.0-beta-02-auth.war

Can you provide a link to the war file you are using?
I am not seeing this error from:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Downloads

https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Downloads is where I found the link "Fedora 4.0.0-beta-02 webapp with authorization" (https://oss.sonatype.org/service/local/repositories/releases/content/org/fcrepo/fcrepo-webapp/4.0.0-beta-02/fcrepo-webapp-4.0.0-beta-02-auth.war). I just fetched it again. It's identical to the WAR I used. I unpacked the new one, and WEB-INF/web.xml contains no <security-role/> elements.

Hmm, I see the warnings, but startup continues successfully. I have created a ticket in pivotal-tracker for adding the elements.
https://www.pivotaltracker.com/story/show/77658788

Did you happen to configure your tomcat-users.xml as described here:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/How+to+Configure+Servlet+Container+Authentication#HowtoConfigureServletContainerAuthentication-Tomcat

In an attempt to reproduce this error, I replaced my customized tomcat-users.xml with an unmodified version... still no error. Mark H. Wood, could you include your catalina.out with this ticket to help debug the issue?

sigh Well, after several restarts and reconfigurations to fix another problem, I cannot reproduce the failure. I must have had something misconfigured, but I don't know what. Sorry to trouble you – this Issue can be closed.
